title: Nvidia earnings live: Nvidia to report Q3 results after the bell with Colette Kress to host first call as interim CEO - Yahoo Finance
description: Nvidia will report its Q3 earnings after the bell Tuesday.

title: FEMA will test its Emergency Alert System today. Here’s what to expect. - The Washington Post
description: Radio and TV broadcasts will be interrupted at around 2:20 p.m. Eastern time to test FEMA’s nationwide public alert and warning system. Cellphones won't be affected.

title: Ray Tintori, filmmaker and boyfriend of ‘SNL’ alum Heidi Gardner, dies at 43 - NBC News
description: Filmmaker Ray Tintori, the boyfriend of former “Saturday Night Live” cast member Heidi Gardner, has died, the New York City medical examiner’s office confirmed Tuesday.

title: Sea turtles laid eggs on a California beach, a first. Now they’ve hatched. - The Washington Post
description: After the first “natural nesting” on record on the West Coast for any species of sea turtle, the tiny hatchlings were released into the ocean.

title: NFL flexes Raiders-Browns to Sunday night in Week 12 - NBC Sports
description: Originally scheduled for SNF, Patriots-Chargers moves to 4:05 p.m. on CBS.
